description: The Coco Data Hub, in the README's step order: the strategic supply chain analysis, the acquisitions' systems inventory, the component-to-platform mapping and supply chain lineage, the data field naming standard (its own batch), the systems' data layer, the strategic digital products, the solution design, the software development governance program, setting up the data sharing hub, and the digital product subscriptions. Includes the folder's notebooks, so it is not idempotent; setting-up-the-data-hub.ipynb needs the optional Unity Catalog runtime. The OpenLineage topic is catalogued by the OpenLineage Events batch, not here: receiving-open-lineage-events.ipynb is a tutorial to run by hand.

canary.name: The AI did it wrong is no excuse!

excludeReasons.receiving-open-lineage-events.ipynb: The OpenLineage Events batch owns openlineage.events (owner 2026-11-12); this tutorial notebook is run by hand and skips cataloguing when the topic exists.
